summary: The claim opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, arguing that it is essential for providing internet access to students and libraries. The claim cites the importance of education and the negative consequences of disconnection and under-education. The claim is made by an individual advocating for the government's role in providing services to the public for the betterment of society.

claims.argument: Taking away funding will cause more disconnection and under-education
claims.evidence_quote: All public schools and libraries should be given the funding to allow students and and anyone else to be able to access the internet. By taking this funding away, it will cause more people to be disconnected and under educated.
